doc.modifier: the [Modifier] to be applied to this navigation rail
doc.containerColor: the color used for the background of this navigation rail. Use [Color.Transparent] to have no color.
doc.contentColor: the preferred color for content inside this navigation rail. Defaults to either the matching content color for [containerColor], or to the current [LocalContentColor] if [containerColor] is not a color from the theme.
doc.header: optional header that may hold a [FloatingActionButton] or a logo
doc.windowInsets: a window insets of the navigation rail.
doc.content: the content of this navigation rail, typically 3-7 [NavigationRailItem]s
